title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Terintambwe Mw'isi Itotahaye programme will work in Kirundo, Cibitoke and Bubanza provinces, Burundi. It aims to contribute to Concern Burundi and Concern Rwanda's Green Graduation thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to ensure households can sustainably meet their basic needs and have improved coping strategies through strengthened livelihoods which place value on the natural environment. The programme will support over 147,220 people living in extreme poor households, including landless, female-headed households, households with disabled members, Batwa community (ethnic minority) . This will be done through support to gain the necessary technical and business skills and financial literacy to be able to set up a suitable livelihood, improved human capital through coaching, mentoring and various life skills training, participation in gender transformative dialogue sessions and environmental enhancement and low carbon development measures are undertaken.OBJECTIVES: Basic needs of Graduation households are met and their food security is improved.OUTCOMES: GOAL Households can sustainably meet their basic needs and have improved coping strategies through strengthened livelihoods which place value on the natural environment
